data.title: bn-3v9e: preserve manual conflict resolutions
data.description: Prevents structured --keep from overwriting hand-resolved paths; adds explicit validated --accept-current, exact conflict-state reporting, path-limited auto-commit, and regression coverage. Verification: just check green.

data.body: LOW (defense-in-depth): the unquoted-safe char set includes '~'. A workspace-relative path like '~/foo.txt' or '~user/x' would be emitted UNquoted in the suggested 'maw ws resolve ... --accept-current -- <path>' command, so pasting it triggers shell tilde-expansion and targets the wrong location. Not an injection risk (these are display-only strings maw never executes, and single-quote escaping is otherwise correct), just a paste-correctness robustness nit. Consider dropping '~' from the safe set here and in merge.rs:3174. Non-blocking.

data.reason: Security review passed. Change is security-positive: adds path-traversal guards (checked_workspace_path rejects absolute/../symlink-escape), symlink-leaf write refusal, validate-before-mutate atomicity, and enforces the conflict-marker gate so --accept-current cannot leak markers/placeholders into default. Git invoked via arg() with -- separators (no shell/injection). One LOW non-blocking nit filed (tilde in unquoted shell-display set, display-only). No CRITICAL/HIGH/MEDIUM findings.

data.body: Fixed in d6f940c2: removed '~' from both unquoted-safe character sets and added a regression test proving suggested paths are quoted against shell tilde expansion. Full just check is green.

Verified fixed in d6f940c2. '~' removed from both unquoted-safe sets (resolve_structured.rs:435 shell_quote and merge.rs:3167 shell_quote_path); regression test shell_quote_prevents_tilde_expansion_in_suggested_commands (resolve_structured.rs:3016) asserts '~/resolved.txt' is quoted and 'normal/resolved.txt' stays unquoted (no over-quoting regression). Remaining safe set (. / - _ + , @ % : = ^) has no unquoted shell-expansion chars outside brace/history contexts. Resolved.
